PECK ATTACK

SWIM

EGG FIRING

TALON TROT

WONDER WING INVULNERABILITY

HOMING EGGS ABILITY
AUTOMATICALLY APPLIED TO ALL EGG FIRING ACTION ONCE OBTAINED.

BABY CLOCKWORK KAZOOIE BOMB.

GRIP GRAB, 35 NOTES

BILL DRILL, 85 NOTES

PACK WHACK, 120 NOTES

SPLIT UP, 160 NOTES

AIRBORNE EGG AIMING, 180 NOTES

WING WHACK, 265 NOTES

TAXI PACK, 405 NOTES

HATCH, 420 NOTES

CLAW CLAMBER BOOTS, 505 NOTES

SHACK PACK, 640 NOTES

THIS BANJO ONLY MOVE HELPS PREVENT HIM GETTING INJURED BY THINGS ON THE GROUND. HOLD [0x88] OR [0x81] AND UP ON THE RIGHT STICK.
